headline: Willow Smith opened up to Kid Cudi about feeling like she wasn’t living up to her potentia
body: Willow Smith opened up to Kid Cudi about feeling like she wasn’t living up to her potential — even with all the privileges of being Will Smith and Jada Pinkett Smith’s daughter. She explained how she had to fight to find her own voice as a musician, saying her album became a real moment of healing: “That album was a catharsis in healing that childhood trauma of like, ‘I’m just not the musician I thought I was.

source_caption_text:
Willow Smith opened up to Kid Cudi about feeling like she wasn’t living up to her potential — even with all the privileges of being Will Smith and Jada Pinkett Smith’s daughter.
She explained how she had to fight to find her own voice as a musician, saying her album became a real moment of healing:
“That album was a catharsis in healing that childhood trauma of like, ‘I’m just not the musician I thought I was. I don’t have the chops like I thought I had.’”
